extName.message: YouTube Pop Out Player: Speed & Loop – Floaty

extDesc.message: YouTube Pop Out Player with speed control, A-B loop, 10s skip and volume. Watch videos in a floating window while you work.

toastNeedClick.message: Click the Floaty button in the player or press Alt+P.

flashA.message: A set, press again at B

popupTagline.message: Watch YouTube in a floating window

popupHow.message: Open a YouTube video, then click the Floaty button in the player or press Alt+P.

rateText.message: Rate it on the Chrome Web Store. It takes 5 seconds and helps a lot.

welcomeLead.message: Watch YouTube in a floating window while you work, with speed and loop controls built in.

step1Text.message: Click the new Floaty button in the player's control bar, or press Alt+P.

step2Text.message: Click the puzzle piece at the top right of Chrome, then the pin next to Floaty.

step3Text.message: Change speed, set an A-B loop or skip 10 seconds without going back to the tab.
